title: Weak closure captures and ARC
summary: Break the ownership cycle between an object and its stored callback with a weak self capture.
triggers: an object owns a closure that refers back to that object
prompts: Track taps with a stored callback while allowing the tracker to deallocate.
invariant: The stored callback does not keep the tracker alive.
mantra: Own the callback; capture the owner weakly.
pitfalls: A strong self capture here creates an object-to-closure-to-object cycle.
A weak reference becomes nil after deallocation, so the callback must tolerate absence.
